name: Stage
why: A change to the site, from one build to private previews, a merge and the live page
ideal: Each change builds once, is staged for the owner, passes the browser tests, merges within minutes and shows on the live page.

steps.name: Build once
tools: The site's build, once per change
steps.rule: Build once per change; every later step reads that build.

steps.name: Stage
tools: A private preview per changed page
steps.rule: Stage each changed page as a private preview; keep the change small enough for one sitting.

steps.name: Browser tests
tools: The budget, origin, words and motion tests
steps.rule: Browser tests check what a visitor sees on each page, not how the code works.

steps.name: Review
tools: A review at the pull request's head
steps.rule: The owner saw the previews, and the pull request is reviewed at its head.

steps.name: Merge
steps.rule: Merge within minutes of all green.

steps.name: Read live
tools: The live page, read in a browser
steps.rule: A change is live only when the live page shows it; read it after each deploy.
